/welcome/invitedBy.v: {configuratorId} ya gayyace ku don yin rajista.

/email/title.v: Ina za mu aika kowace fitowa?

/language/title.v: A wane harshe kuke son karantawa?

/subscribed/subtitle.v: Duba akwatin saƙonku don imel na tabbatarwa.

/form/headingFallback.v: Yi rajista da wannan wasiƙar labarai

/form/intro.v: Sababbin fitowowi suna zuwa ta imel, a rubuce a harshen da kuka zaɓa.

/form/nameHint.v: Muna amfani da shi don gaishe ku. Idan kun bar shi babu komai, za mu yi amfani da farkon adireshin imel ɗinku.

/form/languageHint.v: Mun zaɓi wannan daga saitunan burauzarku.

/form/consent.v: Ta yin rajista, kun amince da karɓar imel daga {sender}. Kowane imel yana da hanyar haɗin cire rajista.

/success/body.v: Mun aika imel na tabbatarwa zuwa {email}. Buɗe shi kuma ku zaɓi Tabbatar da rajista.

/success/next.v: Fitowarku ta farko za ta iso bayan kun tabbatar, a rubuce a {language}.

/success/spam.v: Idan babu abin da ya iso cikin 'yan mintuna, duba babban fayil na spam ko na tallace-tallace.

/errors/emailInvalid.v: Wannan adireshin imel bai cika ba. Duba shi kuma ku sake gwadawa.

/errors/missingLink.v: Wannan hanyar haɗin rajista ba ta da cikakken bayani. Nemi sabuwar hanyar haɗi daga mai aikawa.

/errors/notFound.v: Wannan hanyar haɗin rajista ba ta aiki yanzu. Nemi sabuwar hanyar haɗi daga mai aikawa.

/errors/limit.v: Wannan wasiƙar labarai ba za ta iya karɓar sababbin masu biyan kuɗi a yanzu ba. Sake gwadawa daga baya.

/errors/invalid.v: Ba mu iya karɓar wannan adireshin ba. Duba shi kuma ku sake gwadawa.

/errors/server.v: Ba mu iya ajiye rajistarku ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

/errors/network.v: Ba mu iya isa sabar ba. Duba haɗinku kuma ku sake gwadawa.

/confirm/body.v: Zaɓi maɓallin don fara karɓar fitowowi a {email}.

/confirm/consent.v: Ta tabbatarwa, kun amince da karɓar wannan wasiƙar labarai ta imel. Kuna iya cire rajista daga kowace fitowa.

/confirm/successBody.v: Sababbin fitowowi za su iso a {email}.

/confirm/successTip.v: Don hana su shiga spam, ƙara mai aikawa cikin lambobin sadarwarku.

/confirm/invalidTitle.v: Wannan hanyar haɗi ba ta cika ba

/confirm/invalidBody.v: Sake buɗe imel ɗin tabbatarwa kuma ku zaɓi maɓallinsa. Idan ba ku same shi ba, sake yin rajista daga shafin mai aikawa.

/confirm/notFoundBody.v: Ba mu sami rajista don wannan adireshin ba. Sake yin rajista daga shafin mai aikawa.

/confirm/errorBody.v: Ba mu iya tabbatar da rajistarku ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

/embed/title.v: Ƙara fom ɗin rajista a gidan yanar gizonku

/embed/intro.v: Liƙa ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan lambobin a gidan yanar gizonku. Mutanen da suka yi rajista suna samun imel na tabbatarwa, sannan fitowowinku a harshensu.

/embed/linkHint.v: Raba ta a bayanin kafofin sada zumunta, sa hannun imel ko lambar QR.

/embed/scriptHint.v: Liƙa ta inda fom ɗin zai bayyana. Fom ɗin yana daidaita girmansa da kansa.

/embed/iframeHint.v: Yi amfani da wannan idan gidan yanar gizonku bai yarda da scripts ba.

/embed/copyFailed.v: Zaɓi rubutun kuma ku kwafe shi da hannu.

/embed/accentHint.v: Bar shi yadda yake don amfani da launin alamarku.

/embed/previewNote.v: Samfurin yana aiki kai tsaye. Rajista a nan tana ƙirƙirar mai biyan kuɗi na gaske.

/embed/missing.v: Ƙirƙiri wasiƙar labarai da farko. Fom ɗin rajista zai bayyana a nan idan ta kasance.

/signature/intro.v: Masu karatu suna ganin wannan a ƙarshen kowace fitowa. Danna kowane sashe na samfurin don gyara shi.

/signature/show.v: Nuna sa hannuna a kowace fitowa

/signature/showHint.v: Idan kun kashe shi, fitowowi za su ƙare bayan maƙalar.

/signature/previewEmpty.v: Sa hannunku babu komai. Ƙara sunanku don farawa.

/signature/blocksHint.v: Zaɓi alama don nunawa ko ɓoye wannan sashe. Sassan da aka ɓoye suna riƙe rubutunsu.

/signature/hints/photoUrl.v: Hanyar haɗi zuwa PNG ko JPG mai murabba'i, aƙalla pixels 144 da 144 kuma ƙasa da 200 KB. Ana nuna shi a pixels 72 da 72 kusa da sunanku.

/signature/hints/logoUrl.v: Hanyar haɗi zuwa PNG ko JPG mai bango mara launi ko fari, tsayinsa aƙalla pixels 64. Ana nuna shi a tsayin pixels 32.

/signature/hints/website.v: Muna ƙara https:// idan kun bar shi.

/signature/hints/cta.v: Ana buƙatar rubutun da hanyar haɗin duka domin maɓallin ya bayyana.

/signature/hints/disclaimer.v: Ƙaramin rubutu a ƙasa, misali bayanin sirri. Bar shi babu komai idan ba ku buƙata.

/signature/style/accentHint.v: Ana amfani da shi don sandar, hanyoyin haɗi da maɓalli. Yana farawa da launin alamarku.

/signature/resetConfirm.v: Sake zaɓa don share kowane fili
